hooks.name: player_shear_entity
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerShearEntityEvent)

rust_summary: A player about to shear a mob, cancellable (`native_player_shear_entity`).
doc_summary: A server player about to shear a sheep, mooshroom, snow golem or bogged. `off_hand` says which hand holds the shears; set `cancel` to leave the mob and tool unchanged. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_shear_entity@.
